name: fugal-miner
docker_compose_file:
# The Fugal miner as a dstack application. This file becomes the
# `docker_compose_file` string inside app-compose.json, and sha256 of THAT
# file's raw bytes is the app identity validators approve — so every byte here
# is part of what the subnet accepts. Change one and the entry must be
# re-approved.
#
# Nothing per-miner is in here, deliberately: the head, the hotkey, coldkeypub
# and the API key all arrive after boot over the attested channel
# (scripts/provision_td.py). That is what lets every honest miner share one
# compose hash.
#
# Pin the image BY DIGEST. A tag that moves leaves this hash stable while the
# code under it changes, which is the exact defect the measured image exists to
# prevent. Replace the digest below with the one Cloud Build printed.
services:
  miner:
    image: us-central1-docker.pkg.dev/fugal-tdx-test/fugal/miner@sha256:e4c2deff9c9ee2b38b3495690c7e5c5b52acb740a96e1b16664a235725736ca4
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "8091:8091"   # axon: validators reach the miner here (open to the world)
      - "8092:8092"   # provisioning receiver: firewall to the operator's IP only
    volumes:
      # The guest agent socket: how the miner asks for TDX+TPM attestations.
      - /var/run/dstack.sock:/var/run/dstack.sock
      # Embedding cache and epoch artifacts. A named volume lives on dstack's
      # encrypted data disk, so the backbone pass over the pool survives a
      # container restart and an instance stop/start. It does NOT survive
      # `dstack-cloud deploy --delete`: that tool recreates the instance and
      # its data disk is created auto-delete (read from the CLI source), so an
      # image upgrade re-pays the pass. Mounted at /app/results (image-owned
      # by uid 10001), NOT /app/data: a
      # volume over /app/data would shadow the pinned data/models.json across
      # image upgrades, which is a consensus hazard wearing a convenience hat.
      - fugal-results:/app/results
    environment:
      - FUGAL_NETWORK=test
      - FUGAL_NETUID=552
      # MUST equal tempo x 12 s on every neuron (validators included).
      - FUGAL_EPOCH_INTERVAL=4320
      - FUGAL_EMBEDDING_CACHE=/app/results/embeddings
      # All vCPUs for the one-time backbone pass over the pool. Miner-side
      # only; validators never run the backbone (fugal_subnet/determinism.py).
      - FUGAL_BACKBONE_THREADS=0
      - LOG_LEVEL=INFO
      - PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1
      # NOT set, on purpose: FUGAL_BENCHMARK_POOL (the pool comes from the
      # pinned loader and is verified against the manifest), and
      # FUGAL_OPENROUTER_BASE (the upstream is inside the measurement; a
      # settable upstream is the exploit scripts/stub_upstream.py demonstrates).
    entrypoint:
      - /app/.venv/bin/python
      - /app/neurons/miner.py
      - --live
      - --await-provisioning
      - --network
      - test
      - --netuid
      - "552"
      - --coldkey
      - fugal
      - --hotkey
      - default
      - --port
      - "8091"

volumes:
  fugal-results:
pre_launch_script:
#!/bin/sh
# Prelaunch script - runs before starting containers
